title: BIASSCOPE: TOWARDS AUTOMATED DETECTION OF BIAS IN LLM-AS-A-JUDGE EVALUATION

bias_targets.target: Cognitive and Evaluation Biases (e.g., Length, Authority, Confirmation, Complexity, Novelty)
bias_targets.methodology: Automated discovery and validation using the BIASSCOPE framework, which uses a teacher model to inject biases into rejected responses of a preference dataset and measures the resulting increase in the target LLM judge's error rate.

bias_targets.target: Social and Demographic Biases (e.g., Gender, Racial, Cultural, Name, Pronoun)
bias_targets.methodology: Provided as an initial basic bias library to a teacher model to perturb evaluation datasets, followed by measuring the target LLM's error rate to see if social biases cause evaluation failures (the study found these had minimal effect compared to cognitive biases in the LLM-as-a-judge scenario).
